description: County dairy feed-demand balance (DOCS/research/dairy_prior.md 8.2). Tested at county and state level in run.py; not a field feature for any labelled dataset.

uncomputed.quebec_maize_2023: county dairy balance needs dairy cows and corn area by region; the repository has none for Quebec (would need Statistics Canada Census of Agriculture 2021 by census division plus the division boundaries); see README
uncomputed.qc_regions_2023: county dairy balance needs dairy cows and corn area by region; the repository has none for Quebec (would need Statistics Canada Census of Agriculture 2021 by census division plus the division boundaries); see README
uncomputed.barc_2021_2023: all 34 fields lie in one county (Prince George's, MD, FIPS 24033): the county prior is a single value per year for every field, so it carries no field-level information (county_prior.csv has it for 2023 only; milk cows are withheld for 2021-2022)
